title: Enable live embeddings and indexed search acceptance

context.summary: Make the MVP demonstrably reach indexed document status with a configured embeddings provider.
context.background: The document pipeline works with embeddings disabled, but a full MVP needs real semantic search validation through pgvector using OpenAI-compatible or Ollama embeddings.

in: Document and validate OpenAI-compatible embeddings configuration.
Document and validate Ollama embeddings configuration for local demos.
Update live acceptance so it can require indexed document status when embeddings are enabled.
Verify chunk embeddings are persisted to pgvector.
Verify document semantic search returns source-backed chunks.
Keep disabled embeddings as a supported fallback mode.
out: Hard-require a paid external embeddings provider for all local checks.
Make Qdrant the default vector backend.
Add ranking beyond the MVP semantic search contract.

acceptance_criteria: Configured embeddings provider can process demo document chunks into pgvector rows.
Live acceptance can run in a strict indexed mode and wait for indexed status.
Semantic search returns relevant document chunks with source metadata.
Disabled embeddings mode still reaches chunked status and remains documented.

manual_checks: Run live acceptance with a real embeddings provider when credentials/local model are available.
Confirm fallback mode does not require provider secrets.

risks: Provider configuration may differ between OpenAI-compatible services and Ollama.
Embedding dimensions must match the pgvector schema or indexing will fail.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
